title: REALM: Retrospective Encoder Alignment for LFP Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2605.14867v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Spike activity has been the dominant neural signal for behavior decoding because its high spatiotemporal resolution supports accurate decoding. However, as intracortical brain-computer interfaces (iBCIs) move toward higher channel counts and wireless operation, the high sampling rates required to record spikes create substantial power and bandwidth demands. Local field potentials (LFPs) offer complementary advantages, including greater long-term stability, lower energy consumption, and lower bandwidth requirements. However, LFP-based decoders often achieve lower accuracy and rely on non-causal architectures that cannot be used directly for real-time deployment. We propose REALM, a retrospective knowledge distillation (RKD) framework for causal LFP behavior decoding. Inspired by offline-to-online distillation in speech recognition, REALM transfers non-causal representational knowledge from a pretrained, multi-session bidirection

translated_title: REALM：面向局部场电位建模的回溯编码器对齐
translated_abstract: 尖峰活动一直是行为解码的主要神经信号，因为其高时空分辨率支持精确解码。然而，随着皮层内脑机接口（iBCI）向更高通道数和无线操作方向发展，记录尖峰所需的高采样率带来了巨大的功耗和带宽需求。局部场电位（LFP）提供了互补的优势，包括更强的长期稳定性、更低的能耗和更低的带宽需求。然而，基于LFP的解码器通常精度较低，且依赖无法直接用于实时部署的非因果架构。我们提出了REALM，一个用于因果LFP行为解码的回溯知识蒸馏（RKD）框架。受语音识别中离线到在线蒸馏的启发，REALM将预训练的多会话双向（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出REALM框架，通过回溯知识蒸馏将非因果模型的表达知识迁移到因果模型中，从而实现高精度且可实时部署的LFP行为解码。
en_tdlr: REALM proposes a retrospective knowledge distillation framework that transfers non-causal representational knowledge into causal models, enabling accurate and real-time-deployable LFP-based behavior decoding.
